contentFindings: Both independent cases now require both initial net directions, solute diffusion and water osmosis, under reversed gradients.
The same impermeant salt at 100 versus 20 mmol/L dominates the 0.001 versus 0.01 mmol/L permeable tracer; equal initial pressure and temperature remove an unspecified countergradient.

Expected direction and membrane-permeability reasoning are correct for both cases. The model is deliberately limited to initial net movement; it does not claim long-term equilibrium or learner mastery.
